# Command reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-commands-doc.js (bun run docs:commands). Do not edit by hand. -->

32 slash commands. **Image** `full` means the command needs a CLI tool that only the full Docker image (`BOT_TARGET=full`) ships; elsewhere it is hidden unless the tool is installed. **Cooldown** is per user: heavy 30s, medium 10s, light 3s; every command also counts toward `RATE_LIMIT_DAILY`. **Permission** can also be granted with `OSINT_ALLOWED_ROLES`.

| Command | Description | Permission | Cooldown | Image |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`/bob-airport`](#bob-airport) | Get information about an airport | everyone | light | any |
| [`/bob-blockchain`](#bob-blockchain) | Retrieve blockchain information (addresses, transactions, blocks) | everyone | medium | any |
| [`/bob-blockchain-detect`](#bob-blockchain-detect) | Detect which blockchain network a cryptocurrency address belongs to | everyone | light | any |

## bob-blockchain

Retrieve blockchain information (addresses, transactions, blocks)

### `/bob-blockchain address`

Look up information about a blockchain address/wallet

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blockchain` | text | yes | The blockchain to query | one of: `btc`, `eth`, `ltc`, `bch`, `doge`, `dash`, `zec`, `bsc`, `matic` |
| `address` | text | yes | The blockchain address to look up |  |
| `full` | true/false |  | Return full raw data as JSON |  |
| `network` | text |  | Network to query (default: mainnet) | one of: `mainnet`, `testnet` |

### `/bob-blockchain transaction`

Look up information about a blockchain transaction

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blockchain` | text | yes | The blockchain to query | one of: `btc`, `eth`, `ltc`, `bch`, `doge`, `dash`, `zec`, `bsc`, `matic` |
| `txid` | text | yes | The transaction ID/hash to look up |  |
| `full` | true/false |  | Return full raw data as JSON |  |
| `network` | text |  | Network to query (default: mainnet) | one of: `mainnet`, `testnet` |

### `/bob-blockchain block`

Look up information about a blockchain block

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `blockchain` | text | yes | The blockchain to query | one of: `btc`, `eth`, `ltc`, `bch`, `doge`, `dash`, `zec`, `bsc`, `matic` |
| `block` | text | yes | The block height or hash to look up |  |
| `full` | true/false |  | Return full raw data as JSON |  |
| `network` | text |  | Network to query (default: mainnet) | one of: `mainnet`, `testnet` |

### `/bob-blockchain trace`

Follow the money: trace EVM transaction-flow paths from an address

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `address` | text | yes | Start address to trace (0x...) |  |
| `chain` | text | yes | EVM chain to trace | one of: `1`, `11155111`, `56`, `137`, `42161`, `10`, `8453`, `43114`, `250` |
| `depth` | integer |  | Recursion depth 1-3 (default: 2) | 1 to 3 |
| `max-tx` | integer |  | Max transactions per address per type (default: 25, max 100) | 1 to 100 |
| `direction` | text |  | Which flows to follow (default: both) | one of: `both`, `out`, `in` |
| `types` | text |  | Transaction types to include (default: all) | one of: `all`, `normal`, `internal`, `token` |
| `focus` | text |  | Spotlight one address (0x...) — shows its direct in/out flows in the result |  |

## bob-chat

AI-powered assistant for OSINT analysis and research support

### `/bob-chat ask`

Ask the AI assistant a question or request analysis

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `message` | text | yes | Your question or request for the AI | max 2000 chars |
| `model` | text |  | AI model to use (default: Claude Haiku 5.5) | one of: `us.anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1`, `gpt-6-luna`, `gpt-6.1-sol`, `gpt-6-astra`, `gemini-3.8-flash`, `gemini-4-argon`, `grok-4.7`, `deepseek-flash`, `deepseek-v4-pro`, `qwen3.8-max`, `moonshotai/kimi-k3`, `glm-5.3`, `mistral-medium-3-5`, `meta/muse-wonder`, `sonar`, `sonar-pro`, `sonar-reasoning-pro`, `sonar-deep-research` |
| `context` | text |  | Specialized context for the request | one of: `osint`, `data`, `investigation`, `technical`, `report`, `general` |

### `/bob-chat code`

Generate code for OSINT automation and data analysis

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `request` | text | yes | Describe the code you need | max 2000 chars |
| `language` | text |  | Programming language (default: Python) | one of: `python`, `javascript`, `bash`, `powershell`, `sql`, `other` |
| `model` | text |  | Code model to use (default: Claude Sonnet 5.5) | one of: `us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5`, `us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5`, `gemini-4-argon`, `grok-4.7`, `moonshotai/kimi-k2.7-code`, `deepseek-v4-pro`, `glm-5.3` |
| `new-context` | true/false |  | Start fresh code generation context (default: false) |  |

### `/bob-chat analyze`

Analyze OSINT data, findings, or investigation results

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data` | text | yes | Data or findings to analyze | max 2000 chars |
| `analysis-type` | text |  | Type of analysis needed | one of: `pattern`, `threat`, `link`, `timeline`, `risk`, `summary` |

### `/bob-chat transcribe`

Transcribe uploaded audio (Qwen3 ASR Flash or Phone Call model)

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `audio-url` | text | yes | Asset path from 1min.ai Asset API upload (fileContent.path) | max 512 chars |
| `stt-model` | text |  | Speech-to-text model to use (default: qwen3-asr-flash) | one of: `qwen3-asr-flash`, `phone_call` |
| `language` | text |  | Language code. Required for Phone Call (e.g. en-US), optional for Qwen3 (e.g. en) | max 10 chars |
| `enable-itn` | true/false |  | Qwen3 only: enable inverse text normalization (English/Chinese) |  |

### `/bob-chat reset`

Reset conversation context with AI models

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | text |  | Specific model to reset (default: all) | one of: `all`, `chat`, `code`, `analysis` |

## bob-jwt

Advanced JWT token analysis and manipulation toolkit

### `/bob-jwt analyze`

Decode and analyze JWT token structure and claims

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | text | yes | The JWT token to analyze (format: header.payload.signature) |  |
| `verbose` | true/false |  | Enable verbose output with additional details |  |

### `/bob-jwt tamper`

Modify JWT token claims and re-sign with provided secret

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | text | yes | The JWT token to modify |  |
| `action` | text | yes | Type of modification to perform | one of: `modify`, `add`, `delete` |
| `claim` | text | yes | Name of the claim to modify/add/delete (e.g., "sub", "role", "exp") |  |
| `secret` | text | yes | Secret key to re-sign the JWT token |  |
| `value` | text |  | New value for the claim (required for modify/add actions) |  |
| `algorithm` | text |  | Signing algorithm to use (default: HS256) | one of: `hs256`, `hs384`, `hs512`, `rs256` |

### `/bob-jwt crack`

Attempt to crack JWT signature using dictionary attack

| Option | Type | Required | Description | Allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `token` | text | yes | The JWT token to crack |  |
| `mode` | text |  | Cracking mode (default: dict, uses JWT_WORDLIST) | one of: `dict`, `brute` |
